in_arabic.name: سيرين
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الجميلة، الحسناء، ذات الوجه الحسن
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم سيرين مشتق من الجذر العربي 'س-ي-ر' الذي يعني السير أو الحركة، وقد ورد في بعض الروايات أن النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يسمي بعض نسائه بـ 'سيرين'، ويعني الاسم في هذا السياق الجميلة، الحسناء، ذات الوجه الحسن، والتي تسير في الطريق المستقيم.

in_hindi.name: सिरीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: सिरीन नाम का अर्थ सुंदर, अच्छी शक्ल वाली, खुशहाल होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है और इसका उपयोग मुस्लिम समुदाय में बच्चों के नामकरण के लिए किया जाता है। सिरीन नाम की जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और सुंदरता को दर्शाता है।

in_english.name: Sireen
in_english.meaning: Beautiful, Lovely, Having a Good Face
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sireen originates from the Arabic root 's-y-r', which means 'to move' or 'to walk'. In Islamic tradition, Sireen is a name given to women, meaning beautiful, lovely, having a good face. The name holds significant cultural and spiritual importance, symbolizing inner and outer beauty, kindness, and righteousness. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the values of beauty, morality, and piety.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sireen is of Arabic origin and carries the connotation of a calm, gentle, and elegant individual. The name is a reflection of the grace and gracefulness emphasized in Islamic culture. It is a name that many parents in the Islamic world hope their child will grow up to embody. Sireen is a name that exudes peace and tranquility, and is a testament to the emphasis on good character and behavior in Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Sireen holds great significance. The Arabic root of the name, "s-r-n," is derived from the word "sarhanah," which means to be calm, tranquil and serene. In Islamic tradition, such qualities are highly valued as virtues that lead to a closer connection with Allah (God). By embodying the name Sireen, an individual is encouraged to strive for inner peace, tranquility and gentle strength - qualities that are integral to a devout and fulfilling spiritual life. The name Sireen is thus a reminder of the importance of cultivating a calm and gentle spirit, as a means of drawing closer to Allah and living a meaningful and joyful life.
